message: The other night, I was making dinner and set off the smoke alarm while trying to sauté some veggies. My kids rushed in, wide-eyed, thinking it was an emergency. I had to explain that, no, I wasn’t a fire-breathing dragon, just a dad who forgot to stir the pan. We ended up having a laugh, but it reminded me how important it is to have an escape plan, just in case I ever actually do set the kitchen on fire. Ever had a moment like that?
